savepath: Updated to use the new Super Stash Storage System (SSSS) from Bonesy's update to the D2RLAN launcher. Skills no longer reduce quantity. Annihilus Runeword Infusions have been added! Cubing Annihilus with the runes to make a Vanilla Runeword will add auras and one other powerful property to the charm; this includes all 23 Vanilla Runewords that give an aura when equipped. (NOTICE - these cube recipes only work on newly generated Annihilus charms!!!) Miniature Charms have been added! There are now 94 little buddies you can collect! Miniature Charms can drop from any monster; the drop rates are 1 in 6000 (Normal), 1 in 4000 (Nightmare) and 1 in 2000 (Hell).
